title: meta door: a list view naming a field its object lacks reads with _diagnostics valid and no warning (forms get one since #29196), so the list opens on a rejected query with nothing pointing at the field
body:
repo:cloud#3 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZqfEd7pcckjz3pGqn

Filing gate: **① a product defect with a named location and a measured reproduction.** cloud#4074 measured it (PR cloud#4084, report cloud#4074 comment 6735297830, `pm-orders/cloud/seat3/repro-4074-*`). Not a security finding.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：列表视图里某一列引用了对象上不存在的字段时，元数据接口照样回"有效"（`_diagnostics.valid: true`），没有任何警告。打开列表时查询被拒（400 INVALID_FIELD），页面只显示"该视图的查询被拒绝"，看不出是哪一列错了。
- 对比：表单视图的同类问题已在 #29196 / #29307 解决（读取时带上警告）；列表视图还没有。
- 要做：读取列表视图时，照表单视图的做法，把 lint 已有的 `list-view-field-unknown` 结果放进 `_diagnostics.warnings`。
- 需要你做的：无，分诊定车道。

## Reproduction (objectstack pin 9e1f1f90, cloud main 3177bd3)

- cloud's AI service plugin shipped the `ai_traces` list view with a column `cost_total`; the object declares `total_cost`.
- On a real `objectstack serve` of objectos-ee with the pinned console, the meta read of that view answers `_diagnostics: { valid: true }` with no warning.
- The console projects the grid's columns (`?select=…,cost_total`), the data read answers `400 INVALID_FIELD`, and the list and its `by_model` view open on "This view's query was rejected" with no rows. Nothing on the page or in Studio names the bad column.

## Location (objectstack main 1ff1d45d)

- `packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts` already owns the rule (`list-view-field-unknown`, #14107). It runs only on the authoring paths (`os validate` / build).
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` L447–540: `withFormLayoutWarnings` serves the lint's `form-field-unknown` / `form-section-group-unknown` on a form view's read (#29196, PR #29307; save-time advisories #29389; layered read #29683). There is no list-view counterpart, so the read's `_diagnostics` stays the Zod shape only.
- Plugin-registered views (manifest `views:` from code) never pass `os validate`, so the read is the only place this could surface.

## Wanted

1. A list view's read (single item, list overlay and layered read, as the form fix covers) carries each `list-view-field-unknown` finding in `_diagnostics.warnings`, judged against the object the view binds.
2. The same advisory on save and publish, as #29389 did for forms.
3. Optional and a lane call: the console's "query was rejected" state names the field from the 400, so an operator can tell which column to fix.

## Done when

- The `cost_total` view above reads with a warning naming `columns[…].field: cost_total` on `ai_traces`.
- A valid list view reads with no warning.

## Who acts

- Triage decides the lane (the form fix was `domain:server`, metadata-protocol). cloud has its own guard for its shipped AI views (cloud#4084), so cloud is not blocked.

Dedupe: `org:objectstack-ai is:issue` "list-view-field-unknown plugin manifest": 5 hits, none about the read (nearest objectstack#24563, closed, a different rule); "_diagnostics valid true unknown field view": 37 hits, all the form-view family (#29196, #29021, #29311, #29435, closed).

Related: objectstack#29196, #29307, #29389, #29683, #14107, cloud#4074, cloud#4084.
